channel.title: The Brussels Times
channel.description: Latest posts from The Brussels Times.

item.title: Belgium offers fire engines and tankers to help France battle wildfires
item.description: Minister of the Interior Bernard Quintin said that the French can count on Belgium to provide resources to help extinguish the fires.

item.title: 'Violation of airspace': Probe launched following explosion at Polish border during Russian attack
item.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk is travelling to the site of the explosion in person.

item.title: Wildfires in Europe: How does the EU deploy scarce resources under stress conditions?
item.description: “No country should ever have to face a disaster of this scale alone. Europe will stand with you until the fires are out.”

item.title: Backlash in Europe over Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan
item.description: European football associations will meet in the upcoming days to discuss how to proceed.

item.title: ADL reports highest number of deaths in anti-semitic attacks in decades
item.description: The organisation called for more funding for security, tougher laws and stronger enforcement by social media platforms of their own rules.

item.title: Telegram CEO sent wanted notice by Russia 'for terrorism'
item.description: Paul Durov is accused by the Kremlin of facilitating the training of young Russians for sabotage activities by Ukrainian special services.

item.title: Man who refused to admit that Trump lost election is new US intelligence chief
item.description: During his Senate confirmation hearing, Democratic members repeatedly pressed Jay Clayton on the outcome of the 2020 presidential election.

item.title: Oil prices rising again after resumption of air strikes in Middle East war
item.description: The price of a barrel of West Texas Intermediate, the US benchmark, rose by nearly 5% on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Congo's Constitutional Court clears the way for Tshisekedi third term
item.description: Congo's Constitutional Court rules in favour of a proposed constitutional revision that could pave the way for President Félix Tshisekedi to seek a third term.

item.title: Ghana repatriates its citizens from South Africa due to xenophobic violence
item.description: Ghana has repatriated 216 citizens from South Africa in the past three days as xenophobic violence against migrants escalates.

item.title: Astronomers publish evidence of Betelgeuse's companion star
item.description: Betelgeuse, in the constellation Orion, is visible from Earth with the naked eye and has long been a popular object of study.

item.title: Japan earthquake: Several injured and multiple people trapped inside a shopping centre
item.description: Public broadcaster NHK reported that at least 50 people had been taken to hospital after the earthquake.

item.title: France: Bodies of five newborn babies found at a couple's home
item.description: According to a source close to the investigation, the woman had given birth to a healthy baby as recently as Monday.

item.title: Woman killed in Berlin attack was visiting the city with her daughter
item.description: The victim was a Polish national, Berlin Mayor Kai Wegner said on Monday.

item.title: Off-duty police officer intervenes as man stabs three women in the street in Paris
item.description: Three women were injured in the attack, two of them seriously.

item.title: Germany: Suspected Pride attacker was spared jail after trying to join ISIS
item.description: The decision has prompted fierce criticism from politicians and police officials, who say the state failed to keep adequate watch over a man seen as dangerous.

item.title: Portuguese police find 2.6 tonnes of cocaine on a speedboat in the Atlantic Ocean
item.description: Four people were arrested on board – two Spaniards, one Albanian and a man from Gibraltar.

item.title: EU-funded recovery projects in Gaza and border crossings face bureaucratic hurdles
item.description: “We know that conditions are not met for a full recovery, but conditions could be met for early recovery.”

item.title: Over 15,000 people evacuated in Spanish Valencia as wildfires get out of control
item.description: Authorities said they were struggling to bring the fires under control in the eastern coastal region.

item.title: Six men brought before judge following suspected plan of terrorist attack in Paris suburb
item.description: The investigation began after France’s intelligence received a tip-off about a possible Islamist attack targeting a synagogue in Sarcelles.
